tasks.label: build
tasks.command: docker ps -q --filter ancestor=usdotfhwastol/connectedvcs-tools | xargs -r docker rm -f 2>/dev/null; docker build -t usdotfhwastol/connectedvcs-tools --build-arg USE_SSL=false /workspaces/connectedvcs-tools && docker run -d -p 8080:8080 usdotfhwastol/connectedvcs-tools && echo 'UI available at http://localhost:8080'
